review_rules: Author commentary about a published in-game text is evidence about authorial intent, not automatically evidence that the interpretation is objectively true in-setting.
Morrowind development drafts must remain distinct from shipped Morrowind content.
Competing explanations of the Dwemer disappearance and Battle of Red Mountain remain separate attributed models.
Khajiit development material must be dated so early concepts are not silently projected onto later ESO-era lore.
Cross-link to existing Red Mountain, Tribunal, Dwemer, Khajiit and 36 Lessons subject records.
